properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 17 at 2:18PM EDT until September 18 at 10:00AM EDT by NWS Northern Indiana
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Jay County in east central Indiana...
Adams County in northeastern Indiana...
Huntington County in northeastern Indiana...
Wells County in northeastern Indiana...

* WHEN...Until 1000 AM EDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Numerous roads
remain closed due to flooding.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 216 PM EDT,Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms had come to an end. However, due to recent heavy
rainfall Flooding, areal flooding is expected to continue tonight
into Friday morning. Emergency mangement reports continued
flooding across the warned area with several roads closed.
Between 2 and 5 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.5 inches are possible in the
warned area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Huntington, Bluffton, Decatur, Berne, Geneva, Andrews, Markle,
Monroe, Warren, Lancaster, Preble, Nottingham, Uniondale, Bryant,
Poneto, Mount Etna, Vera Cruz, Travisville, North Oaks and
Wellsburg.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.description:

* WHERE...Southeastern Lincoln County in central New Mexico...

* IMPACTS...Flood waters in Whitetail Canyon will flow into the Rio
Felix overnight into Friday morning. Flooding of low water
crossings along the Rio Felix are expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

thunderstorms. Flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly

warned area. Impacts are expected within Whitetail Canyon, along
Picacho Road, including Clements Ranch, in and along the Rio
Felix.

Chaves Counties.

properties.areaDesc: Citrus, FL; Levy, FL; Marion, FL
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 18 at 9:18AM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

Withlacoochee At US 41 Dunnellon affecting Marion, Levy and Citrus
Counties.

.The Withlacoochee River at Dunnellon has been steadily rising since
July, and on September 15 reached flood stage. The cause of the high
water along the Withlacoochee River at Dunnellon is due to excessive
hydrilla growth (from the river bottom to the water surface) along a
4.5 mile stretch of river between US 41 and Lake Rousseau.  The
hydrilla is acting like a dam and holding water back, causing water
levels to rise.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Withlacoochee at US 41 Dunnellon.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 28.2 feet, Docks and boat ramps flood along the river
in Citrus and Marion counties.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:45 AM EDT Friday the stage was 28.2 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 28.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage this
afternoon and continue rising to 28.2 feet this afternoon.
Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 28.2 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 28.2
feet on 10/02/1979.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
